messages:
mina: heads up — i found a mismatch between the econ dashboard and the cache savings ledger after the sticky-v2 rollout. looks like some 'stitch' requests are being counted as prefetch savings.

devin: can you attach an example trace id?

mina: trace 0x9a3c from yesterday's sample run. dashboard shows ~120 tokens saved (prefetch) but billing export has 0 prefetch credits. metadata: router=sticky-v2, model=mosaic-4b-q8, stitch_id=stitch-12, cache_hit=true

alejandra: hmm. we purposely separate "kv_stitch" (server-side assembly/kv reuse) from actual prefetch claims. if origin tag is missing, the attributor currently defaults to prefetch which is wrong for stitches.

sam: quick recap: telemetry emits cache_hit=true and origin in {prefetch, kv_stitch, live}, but origin often arrives late for stitched requests because router rewrites happen mid-pipeline. attributor maps missing origin -> prefetch credit.

gabi: low friction fix: update attributor precedence: if stitch_id present -> credit as kv_stitch; else use origin enum; else fallback to legacy assumption. safer than forcing router changes.

devin: agree. i'll implement: attribution_reason precedence = [stitch_id, origin_enum, fallback]. add unit tests for origin=null with stitch_id set.

alejandra: also add a new metric: telemetry.tagging.stitch_origin_missing_count and a ratio gauge stitch_origin_missing_ratio. create an alert if >1% of cache_hits in 1m have missing origin.

sam: flag: sticky-v2's two-phase routing rewrites request body after tokenization which likely strips origin. we should review router rewrite timing too, but that's medium effort.

gabi: for dashboard UX: make a tooltip clarifying "stitch credits are internal KV reuse — not billable prefetch credits." and add a small badge on the per-model econ export for attribution_reason (stitch,inferred-prefetch,explicit-prefetch,none). this will help billing reconciliation.

devin: ops-bot: scheduling canary for attributor patch on staging at 15:30 PT.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary started: attributor-v1.8.2-canary — monitor /deploy/attributor-canary and /metrics/attributor.*

mina: once canary passes, can we ask data-team to re-run the 24h aggregation so we can verify dashboard vs ledger converge before prod?

devin: yes. i'll add the gauge, the precedence change, and a small backfill flag to trigger a delta-run. PR will include a changelog note about "no silent historical rewrites; default view uses new attribution but legacy toggle available for audits."

alejandra: please also update the econ telemetry contract doc: https://redwood.internal/doc/econ-telemetry/contract — add attribution_reason enum and note that stitch_id implies kv_stitch.

sam: suggests we add a dashboard panel showing stitch vs prefetch share over time so product teams can see the effect of routing changes.

gabi: agreed. final ask: add an export column in the per-model econ CSV: attribution_reason, and a short human_readable_reason for ops.

mina: thanks all. should reduce the number of "why are my prefetch credits missing" tickets.

devin: PR opened: GH #4821. will ping when canary metrics look stable; aiming for prod rollout tomorrow after lunch if green.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary metrics OK after 20m sample. ready for wider rollout pending data-team re-aggregation.
file_note: thread about reconciling stitch vs prefetch attribution and dashboard UX
